title: Round 3: more vibrant
question: A more vibrant hand, led by Dabbawala Codes. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Dabbawala Codes
options.lineage: the painted colour codes on Mumbai dabbawala tiffin lids
options.thesis: Mumbai's dabbawalas route 200,000 lunches a day without a mix-up using painted lid codes; every email here carries one, so nothing gets sent twice.
options.viewport: Cobalt top bar; KPI fields painted in the code colours; follow-ups with a round painted code per investor (colour = stage, letters = owner and list).
options.risk: With four bright code colours, discipline matters: each colour means one status only, everywhere.

raised.raise: Every status also has a shape (solid, ring, half, struck), so colour is never the only signal.
On check results, rows you act on get circled and handled rows get struck through.
Every upload gets a sequence number (UPL-0042), so lists can be referred to exactly.
All rules and dividers are drawn at exactly one pixel, never heavier.

options.label: Run Chase
options.thesis: The week is a run chase: 312 of 500 with four days left, required rate against current rate, and a worm chart of the week.
options.viewport: Purple score bar with 'Need 188 from 4 days'; the week's worm chart; a team scorecard of who contacted how many; follow-ups beside.
options.risk: The most familiar Indian metaphor for a target; must not turn into a leaderboard that pressures the team.

options.label: Transit Map
options.thesis: The pipeline is a metro line: stages are stations, counts sit at each stop, and owners' lines interchange.
options.viewport: Midnight-blue overview with the pipeline drawn as coloured lines and stations; follow-ups on a porcelain-white panel beside it.
options.case: Most vivid and great for the pipeline; the dark ground is heavier for long table work.
options.risk: A dark ground for a full working day; tables need the white panel.

options.label: High-density Mosaic
options.thesis: Everything on one screen: dozens of small ruled modules with red tabs, packed edge to edge.
options.viewport: A mosaic of target, hashmap, campaigns, follow-ups, owners, uploads and alerts modules, each with a red tab.
options.case: Best for seeing everything at once; small type is harder for a long day.
options.risk: Dense to the point of clutter if modules multiply.

options.label: Emission Lines
options.thesis: Colour only as hairlines on charcoal; state as line shape.
options.case: The opposite of vibrant; too abstract for tables.
options.kept: State also carried by line shape, not only colour.

options.label: Convention Catalog
options.thesis: Thousands of stamp-sized cells on newsprint.
options.kept: Circle what you act on, strike what's done.

options.label: Factory Catalog
options.thesis: Everything numbered; colour strips stand in for words.
options.viewport: A black field with one pulse plot.
options.case: Coded labels slow a working team down.
options.kept: Every artifact gets a sequence number.

options.label: Centre-rail Edition
options.thesis: Two columns around a centre rail of keys.
options.viewport: A small text block in a wide margin.
options.kept: Every rule at exactly one pixel.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS analytics dashboard (Linear / Stripe style), executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Left sidebar, KPI cards across the top, a chart and a follow-ups table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other dashboard by design.
